summary: Labels a person applied and can take away: active filters, the labels on a record, recipients. Neutral and removable, unlike Badge.
useWhen: showing which filters are applied, each removable on its own
the labels or categories someone attached to a record
a set of chosen values — recipients, assignees — shown after they are picked

useInstead.when: it is a status the system reports — Failing, Paid, Draft
the chips toggle on and off rather than being removed
several options can be switched on at once from a fixed list

composition.note: Tag is react-stately's collection Item: `key` identifies it and is what `onRemove` hands back, children are its label. Pass `items` and a render function for a list that changes.
composition.example: <TagGroup label="Active filters" onRemove={(keys) => drop(keys)}><Tag key="status">Status: Failing</Tag><Tag key="team">Team: Finance</Tag></TagGroup>

sm.use: the default — filter rows, table toolbars, dense record headers

md.use: a group that is the main content of its area, or sits beside md controls

guarantees: the group is one tab stop; arrow keys move between tags
each remove button is named "Remove" plus the tag's label, so a screen reader hears which one
Delete or Backspace on a focused tag removes it, and focus moves to its neighbour
removing the last tag moves focus to the group, which reads `emptyLabel`, instead of dropping it to the page
requires: a `label` or `aria-label` — it names the group, so "Remove Finance" is heard as a filter being removed
`textValue` on a Tag whose children are not plain text
`onRemove` to drop the keys from your own list; the group removes nothing itself
notes: No selection. A chip that toggles is a SegmentedControl or a Checkbox, which already announce "selected" the way screen readers expect.

antiPatterns.why: tags are neutral and removable; a status is neither — use Badge

antiPatterns.dont: `onRemove` that does not remove the tag
antiPatterns.why: the button says "Remove", focus moves on, and the tag is still there — the one thing the control promised did not happen

antiPatterns.dont: a filter row with no way to clear everything at once
antiPatterns.why: removing six filters one by one is six targets; pair the group with a "Clear filters" Button
